terminals.name: convex
terminals.description: Isolated anonymous Convex backend (serves port 3210 and watches functions).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous && bunx convex dev

terminals.name: worker
terminals.description: Factory worker that drives the Job state machine. Runs in mock mode unless CURSOR_API_KEY is set.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3210/version >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && export CONVEX_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3210 && bun run dev:worker

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Factory UI on port 5173.
